summary: Iteration 3 testing (customer types/price lists, route planner, stock requests, yearly plans). Backend: 44/44 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py pass (100%). Covered: /api/customer-types CRUD (OWNER write, ANY_ORG read, empty name/invalid price -> 400); customers accept type_id/lat/lng; POST /api/sales ignores client price -> uses customer-type price (8.0) when set, else product sale_price (15.0); sale with lat/lng back-fills customer.lat/lng when missing; /api/sales-returns also uses locked type price. Routes: POST /api/routes (OWNER upsert keeps VISITED/SKIPPED statuses, 404 for bad distributor, 403 for agent write); GET /api/routes filter by date+distributor_id; GET /api/routes/mine (today default); POST /routes/{id}/optimize nearest-neighbor returns unlocated count, accepts owner, denies accountant; POST /routes/{id}/stops/{cid}/status VISITED/SKIPPED/PENDING + 400 for bad status; DELETE /routes/{id}. Stock requests: idempotent by client id, empty rejected, agent-only create, owner lists all / agent lists own; /fulfill creates delivery and increments agent inventory by exact qty (verified 0->30), /fulfill with insufficient warehouse -> 400 and request stays PENDING; /reject marks REJECTED; /fulfill on non-pending -> 404; /api/my/inventory now includes min_stock. Yearly plans: dev yearly_price persisted; /upgrade-requests billing=yearly uses yearly_price (1000) and days=365 with 'سنوي' label; billing=yearly on plan without yearly_price -> 400; monthly still works (price=50, days=30). Regression: iter1 (34) + iter2 (38/39) pass -- the single iter2 fail (TestIdempotency::test_sale_idempotent_no_double_apply) is a stale-state artifact: STATE from prior runs leaves inv_before==inv_after because the fixed sale id was already recorded, so first POST short-circuits via idempotency; re-running after a full DB reset passes. Not a product bug. Frontend web preview (390x844): OWNER tab-more exposes segment-routes/segment-prices/segment-deliveries/segment-tracking/segment-team/segment-profile. segment-routes renders route-agent-select, date segments segment-YYYY-MM-DD (today + 6 days), route-add-customer-select, plan-stop-N / plan-stop-up-N / plan-stop-down-N / plan-stop-remove-N, plan-stop-map-N (when customer has geo), save-route-button, optimize-route-button, delete-route-button. segment-prices renders add-customer-type-button + customer-type-{id} rows and the sheet (customer-type-sheet) has type-price-input-N + save-customer-type-button. segment-deliveries lists stock-request-{id} with fulfill-request-{id} / reject-request-{id}. AGENT home renders my-route with route-stop-N + stop-visited-N / stop-skip-N / stop-directions-N / stop-undo-N, optimize-my-route-button, my-stock-{pid} + request-stock-{pid} + request-low-stock-button (bulk), and my-stock-request-{id} status cards. NewSale: sale-customer-select, add-line-select, sale-paid-input, sale-notes-input, submit-sale-button; line-price-N is a Text (read-only) label with caption 'السعر (حسب فئة العميل)' when customer has type_id -- NO price input exists in the lines, confirming server-side price locking. OWNER /upgrade shows segment-monthly / segment-yearly toggles and save-badge-{planId} for plans with yearly_price (observed 'وفّر 18%'); dev billing plan form exposes plan-yearly-price-input. All critical interactive elements use testIDs and all text is wrapped in <Text>; no React Native red screen.
action_items: (Optional) Scope idempotency lookup in /api/sales etc. by {id, org_id} already done in iter3 -- confirmed. The iter2 TestIdempotency flake is DB-state driven; consider isolating with per-run unique UUIDs or deleting idempotent docs in a module-level fixture to make reruns clean.
(Optional) In price_for, consider logging when a product has no sale_price so the sale isn't silently 0-priced; current behaviour returns 0.0 which could create a 0-total sale.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1272 lines (grew by ~240 lines for iter3). Routes/stock-requests/customer-types are three clearly separable domains -- consider splitting into routers (routes.py, stock_requests.py, customer_types.py) for maintainability before iteration 4.
price_for() returns 0.0 when product is missing -- should raise HTTPException(404, 'المنتج غير موجود') to fail fast instead of silently writing a zero-priced line.

optimize_route picks cur = located[0] when distributor has no last_location AND no body.lat -- this is fine but the resulting first-stop ordering becomes a tie-break on insertion order. Acceptable but note in UI that an initial GPS fix improves accuracy.
_build_stops uses dict.fromkeys(customer_ids) to dedupe -- good. However it silently drops customer_ids that don't resolve to a customer; a 400 with the bad id would make UI debugging easier.
fulfill_stock_request calls create_delivery() which raises HTTPException(400) on insufficient warehouse. The stock_request row stays PENDING -- verified in test. Good.
StockReqIn.items uses DeliveryLine but note DeliveryLine lacks min/max qty validation; a client could post quantity=0 and still succeed. Minor.
customer-types prices dict is unvalidated against product_id existence -- stale/leftover product keys will persist in the dict. Low priority.
Good: price locking enforced on BOTH /sales and /sales-returns; type_id null-out on delete; owner-write + any-org-read scoping; idempotency with org_id scoping on stock-requests.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://text-fixer-32.preview.emergentagent.com. Tokens in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. IMPORTANT: pytest.ini sets -n 2 --dist loadscope, but iter2/iter3 suites rely on module-level STATE across test classes, so run with -n 0 (e.g. `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration3.py -n 0`). Running under default (-n 2) splits classes across workers and the STATE dict is not shared, producing cascading KeyErrors (seen first-run on iter3). For a clean regression on iter2 TestIdempotency, drop the sales/collections/sales_returns documents with ids starting 'sale-idem-fixed','col-idem-fixed','ret-idem-fixed' before rerunning, or seed with fresh UUIDs. Iter3 testIDs confirmed in /app/frontend/src/components/{RoutePlanner,MyRoute,StockRequests,PriceLists}.tsx and /app/frontend/app/upgrade.tsx + /app/frontend/app/dev/billing.tsx.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no product bugs found in iter3. Regression flake on iter2 TestIdempotency::test_sale_idempotent_no_double_apply is a test-data-reuse issue: the sale id 'sale-idem-fixed-1' persists across runs, so the first POST short-circuits via idempotency and inv_before==inv_after (147.0==147.0). Fix: either delete the idempotent sale in a per-run fixture or compute inv_before BEFORE the first POST within a transaction-reset context. Confirmed by inspecting the POST path at server.py:543-548 which correctly returns the pre-existing doc without re-applying inventory.
